question.text: Minimum investment in an AIF (regulatory) per investor:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI AIF Regs mandate Rs. 1 crore minimum (Rs. 25 lakh for AIF employees/directors under conditions). The Trap: Other values misstate the rule. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Confirm the client can lock-in Rs. 1 crore+ before recommending AIFs.
